lines.zh: 我四条腿走，但能站起来。
lines.en: I walk on four legs, but I can rise.
My long tail drags through the leaves.
I am the largest thing here.
I keep along the riverbank.
Each step sinks the soil.
Head up, I stand above the trees.
I do not detour. Walking around costs more.
I snap a dead log.
This wood belongs to me.
I walk steadily, unhurried.
I read the tracks on the ground.
I take the bend slowly.
The wind runs along my spine.

lines.zh: 我抬头叫了一声，林子回音。
lines.en: I call once, and the woods answer.
This mud suits me.
I follow the water. Better hunting.
I lie with my jaw on the ground.

lines.zh: 我伏在泥里，听蹄声和虫鸣。
lines.en: I lie in the mud, listening to hooves and insects.

lines.zh: 我闭不上嘴，钝牙总露在外面。
lines.en: I cannot close my mouth; blunt teeth always show.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的北美，我是最大的。
lines.en: In Triassic North America, I was the largest.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地眨了一下眼，三叠纪的日头很毒。
lines.en: I blink slowly; the Triassic sun is harsh.
The water is running.

lines.zh: 我趴着不动，尾巴偶尔拍泥。
lines.en: I lie still, tail occasionally slapping the mud.
This quiet is unnatural.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的北美，我说了算。
lines.en: Triassic North America was mine.
I wait for dark.

lines.zh: 我一呼一吸，肋骨慢慢起伏。
lines.en: I breathe in and out, ribs rising slowly.
My prints are in the ground.
I smell blood.
I swing my tail once.

lines.zh: 这是我的河湾，你踩进来了。
lines.en: This is my river bend, and you stepped in.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，像看一只幼崽。
lines.en: I look down at you as at a hatchling.

lines.zh: 我抬起方头，露出满口钝牙。
lines.en: I lift my boxy head, baring a mouth of blunt teeth.
You do not carry the smell of this place.

lines.zh: 我看你的腿，估你能跑多远。
lines.en: I eye your legs, judging how far you can run.
Do not turn around.
My teeth are not ornament.
In Triassic North America, my word stands.
Twenty paces between us.
Two steps, I have counted; that reaches you.
I back half a step and roar.
That tore my hide.

lines.zh: 三叠纪北美，最大的掠食者。
lines.en: Triassic North America's largest predator.
I lower myself to recover.
Blood drips from my jaw.
It hurts, and I can still bite.

lines.zh: 厚皮被划开，我拖着尾巴退开。
lines.en: My thick hide splits, and I drag my tail back.
I turn the wound away.

lines.zh: 三叠纪最大的嘴，朝你张开了。
lines.en: The Triassic's largest jaws open at you.
Again, my back plates have not cracked.
What is that?
I am not picky, if it is big enough.

lines.zh: 你把肉扔过来，我张口接住。
lines.en: You toss the meat, and I catch it.
That will not fill a tooth gap.

lines.zh: 那点肉，只够我润润喉咙。
lines.en: That little meat would only wet my throat.
Lower your hand.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味顺着河谷飘过来。
lines.en: The smell of carrion drifts down the river valley.

lines.zh: 钦利组的泥沼，我一脚就过。
lines.en: One stride takes me across Chinle marsh.
Feed me and I will not bite.
That one I count as a favor.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的顶层猎手，腿很粗。
lines.en: Top predator of the Triassic. Thick legs.
I shifted, and the ground moved.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞一截湿木头。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a wet log.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴横过来，抽在你膝上。
lines.en: My tail swings across and cracks against your knee.

lines.zh: 我用肩撞开你，皮都没擦破。
lines.en: I shoulder you aside without a scratch.
I gave half a step of room.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴骨撞在你腿上，你歪了。
lines.en: My tail bone hits your leg, and you stumble.

lines.zh: 这片三叠纪是我的猎场。
lines.en: This Triassic ground is my hunting range.
I step over your head.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲把你顶到一边。
lines.en: The armor of my shoulder shoves you aside.
This ground can hold two.
We lie side by side.
Its spine is darker than mine.

lines.zh: 我四条腿走，但也能站起来。
lines.en: I walk on four, but I can rise up too.
That flat ground by the bank is right.
It leads. I follow behind.
Our calls carry a long way.
This water can raise young.
It quiets, and there is only water.
When we part, each goes to the water.
A piece this big, I take.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，慢慢挪回水边。
lines.en: I carry it slowly back to the water.

lines.zh: 我叼起骨头，咬了两下就吐了。
lines.en: I pick up a bone, bite twice, and spit it out.
It drags a line in the dirt.
No use. Dropped.

lines.zh: 我叼起那件东西，闻了闻。
lines.en: I pick the thing up and sniff it.
I pin it under a claw.

lines.zh: 这东西有铁锈味，不是肉。
lines.en: This tastes of rust, not meat.

lines.zh: 劳氏鳄不抢地上的东西。
lines.en: A rauisuchian doesn't take what's on the ground.

lines.zh: 我把它压在石头下，藏起来。
lines.en: I wedge it under a stone and hide it.

lines.zh: 你走在我的影子里，还不知情。
lines.en: You walk in my shadow without knowing.
I am on my feet.
My spine has risen.

lines.zh: 这一片地盘，我第一个到。
lines.en: I was first to this territory.

lines.zh: 我伏在河边，肚皮贴着泥。
lines.en: I lie at the riverbank, belly against the mud.
The Chinle ruler is me.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚出一声低鸣。
lines.en: A low rumble rolls from my throat.
I bring my head down.

lines.zh: 我张开颌，朝你的方向扑。
lines.en: I open my jaws and lunge your way.
I burst out, throwing up a spray of water.

lines.zh: 我的吻端对准了你的喉咙。
lines.en: My snout lines up with your throat.

lines.zh: 你躲到树后，我的尾巴已经绕过去。
lines.en: You hide behind a tree; my tail is already circling.

lines.zh: 这条退路，我已经堵住了。
lines.en: I have already blocked this retreat.

lines.zh: 你退到泥里，我的尾巴扫过去。
lines.en: You back into the mud, and my tail sweeps across.
The trees are behind you.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫断了一丛草。
lines.en: My tail cuts through a clump of grass.

lines.zh: 我把你这边的路堵住了。
lines.en: I have closed this side.
You are looking for a way out.
I found mine.
Water splashes up under my feet.

lines.zh: 我贴着河岸挪，泥没到脚踝。
lines.en: I creep along the bank, mud to my ankles.
Right here.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，喉部鼓了一下。
lines.en: I raise my head and my throat swells.

lines.zh: 我选好落点，尾巴先扫过去。
lines.en: I pick my spot and sweep my tail ahead.

lines.zh: 我算好距离，后腿已经绷紧。
lines.en: I have the distance; my hind legs are taut.

lines.zh: 我的颌骨合上，牙陷进骨头。
lines.en: My jaws close, teeth sinking into bone.
All the teeth go in.

lines.zh: 我咬住，甩头把肉撕下来。
lines.en: I bite down and wrench my head to tear the flesh.
Forelimbs pin you; the teeth follow.
Bone broke on that one.
It is dragged into the water.
The water goes red.
I rise, and I am far taller.
I hold it down with a foot.
This will feed me for days.
I raise my head, blood on my jaw.
Nothing else.

lines.zh: 我从河岸的泥里站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the riverbank mud.
This ground is not quite mine.
I am the largest thing here.

lines.zh: 晚三叠世的北美，我是最大的。
lines.en: In Late Triassic North America, I was the biggest.
Where is the water?

lines.zh: 风里有血味，我从泥里起身。
lines.en: Blood on the wind; I rise from the mud.

lines.zh: 泥水从我背上滑下，我抬起头。
lines.en: Mud slides off my back as I raise my head.

lines.zh: 这世界比我的时代安静。
lines.en: This world is quieter than my time.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，热气从牙缝里出来。
lines.en: I open my mouth and heat escapes my teeth.
First I look for water.
Something is moving the trees far off.
I take a step, and the ground answers.
I do not know the prey here.
I head down the slope.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背，皮全卷了。
lines.en: Fire curls the hide on my back.

lines.zh: 从这么高摔下，骨头都麻了。
lines.en: A fall from that height numbs my bones.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我猛地把头抬起。
lines.en: Water floods my throat and I jerk my head up.
The blast flips me over.
Something sticks in my flank.
This force makes me unsteady.
Hungry this long, even my walk slows.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的背上，眼前一白。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and everything whitens.
No ground below, and no water.
